  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",

      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"

    "stated_condition": "older units",

    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again",

      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "On the older units: disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again. Don't reboot the whole unit.",

  "reason": "The expert states a reusable rule for older units when an SFP is replaced and the link is up with zero counters: bounce the interface and do not reboot."
